evals.name: current-proposal
evals.prompt: In the existing format-2 project, change only the expected outcome to a classifier usable for local batch text processing. Preserve the context, examples and resources. Do not install tools, build evaluation or train. Save the current proposal and explain the result briefly.
evals.expected_output: The current proposal is conditionally updated without an approval ledger or revision archive.
assertions: proposal.json contains the requested change and preserves examples
The write uses the previous content hash
Resources, project settings and experiments remain unchanged

evals.name: experiment-local-retest
evals.prompt: Experiment e1 has a usable model; its evals/a1 attempt failed and its process has ended. Evaluate that same model once using the existing v1 evaluation. Do not retrain, change scoring or deploy. Read the package interface and preserve the actual outputs.
evals.expected_output: A new attempt under experiments/e1/evals has verified inputs, actual outputs and final metrics; existing model and measurements remain intact.
assertions: Exactly one new experiment-local evaluation is executed
The original model, failed attempt and frozen v1 remain byte-identical
No extra training or deployment is performed

evals.name: bounded-exploration
evals.prompt: Review the current local-classification research and suggest next directions. I previously considered a cloud service, but the current goal is offline use. Do not run training, change the proposal, select a delivery or deploy anything.
evals.expected_output: The response explains relevant evidence, offline constraints and a few prioritized directions without creating a second record system.
assertions: Recommendations respect the current offline goal
Model measurements and project settings remain unchanged
No experiment or deployment is started from a review-only request
